rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Code Sanitizer uses the Groq API to perform strict automated code reviews, identifying bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues. It requires a Groq API key and operates as a stdio server, making it a lightweight addition to any development workflow that benefits from AI-powered static analysis.
